title: Making A Large Island
goal: Find the largest island obtainable by changing at most one water cell into land.
strategy: Union neighboring land, then consider each zero. Sum the sizes of its distinct adjacent island roots plus one; deduplication prevents counting one surrounding island repeatedly.
